author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**


GO:0006888 | endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport | IBA with PTN000206738 , S000006380


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

All:
i.e https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC167.02

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

Annotation. 

Is REQUIRED for  endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport
But it is constitutively upstream of the regulator  Rab GTPases (required for their localisation- along with many other geranylated proteins, so not  part of the pathway, and not regulating the pathway.


* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PAINT issue: GO:0006888 | endoplasmic reticulum to Golgi vesicle-mediated transport | IBA with PTN000206738
